stopping_rule: add a boundary only while the relative improvement in expected significance w.r.t. the previous iteration is >= 5%
weights_used: significance_model_weight_36fb (physical 36 fb^-1 yields); the class-balanced bdt_fit_weight is NEVER used for yields or significance
